notable_absence.finding: Unlike the three tool-specific configure pages in this batch (configure-slack-integration.md, configure-microsoft-integration.md, configure-webhook-integration.md), this generic page's Prerequisites section lists only roles and required fields (name, URL, auth method) - it never states the Enterprise/Developer Pro Support Plan gate that all three tool-specific pages state identically. This generic page appears to be a role/API-reference-oriented duplicate of the tool-specific pages' shared content, omitting the plan gate rather than contradicting it.

cross_component_finding: This page's Prerequisites list (Organization Owner / Project Creator / Project Owner / Cluster Manager for full access; Organization Member with Read + Data Reader for read-only) is reused verbatim, word for word, across all three tool-specific configure pages in this batch - a single, genuinely shared configuration-model detail (access control for alert integrations doesn't vary by third-party tool, confirming the batch hypothesis's 'shared model' side for at least the access-control dimension, even though payload format varies).
